key: folk:crocodile:The Magma Stalker|theropod|volcano|charcoal|Late Cretaceous, 68 million years ago|

narrator.persona: a calm, warm storyteller, like a nature documentary narrator who is quietly afraid

sentences.text: For countless ages, the tyrant lizard ruled this deep valley as the undisputed apex predator, and nothing in the ancient world ever dared to hunt it.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Tremendous herds of long necked giants and swift flying reptiles kept a wide berth from the monarch whenever his thunderous challenge echoed through the dense ferns.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Then the ancient volcano that had slept for thousands of years began to shudder, splitting the black earth and silencing every creature in the forest.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It erupted in a sudden storm of ash, liquid fire, and rolling thunder, sending every dinosaur fleeing in panic until even the proud king turned to run.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Deep inside the glowing molten crater, heavy smoke and falling ash twisted together to form a colossal shape born entirely from destruction.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The massive entity opened burning eyes and took its first fiery breath, rising taller than the old king while the stone beneath it melted.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Refusing to yield his throne, the tyrant lizard stepped forward to challenge the new arrival, but his mighty roar was silenced in a single flash.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Now a new master walks the scorched earth with glowing veins, and which of you would dare to face a predator forged in a volcano.
sentences.speaker: narrator
